units.source_text: 尽管如此，我依然不言一声，与他对峙着。

en.t: Even so, I still stood facing him without saying a word.

units.source_text: 这时，孩子们的棒球扔们了，滚到我们两人中间来了。

en.t: Just then, the children's baseball came rolling into the space between us.

units.source_text: 柏木想把它捡起扔回去，于是弯下腰来。

en.t: Kashiwagi bent down, meaning to pick it up and throw it back.

units.source_text: 我生起一段恶作剧的兴趣，我想看他是怎样活动他的X型的腿，

en.t: A mischievous curiosity rose in me; I wanted to see how he would move his X-shaped legs

units.source_text: 让手够着落在前面一尺远的棒球。

en.t: so that his hand could reach the baseball lying about a foot in front of him.

units.source_text: 我的目光无意识地落在他的腿上。

en.t: My gaze fell unconsciously on his legs.

units.source_text: 柏木察觉之快，可以说简直是神速的。

en.t: Kashiwagi noticed it with a speed one could almost call miraculous.

units.source_text: 他挺直了还没有完全弯下的腰板，凝视着我。

en.t: He straightened his back before he had fully bent over and stared hard at me.

units.source_text: 他的眼睛含有一种不像是他的、缺乏冷静的憎恨。

en.t: In his eyes was a hatred unlike him, stripped of composure.
